# SEO and GEO audit: quay-store (SvelteKit) I read all 9 tracked files. Problems are ordered by severity. ## Critical **1. `src/routes/+layout.ts:1`: `export const ssr = false;`** - This turns the whole site into a client-rendered SPA. The server sends an empty shell. - Most AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others) don't run JavaScript. They see no title, content, canonical, or JSON-LD. - Googlebot has to render the page in a second pass, which delays indexing. - **Fix:** delete the line, or set `ssr = true`. If a single route needs client-only rendering, set it on that route. **2. `static/robots.txt:4-5`: `User-agent: Googlebot` / `Disallow: /`** - This blocks Google from the entire site. Googlebot follows its own group and ignores the `*` group, so the `Allow: /` on line 2 doesn't help. - **Fix:** delete lines 4-5. If you want to block specific paths, list them under `User-agent: *`. - Also decide on AI crawlers. Add explicit `Allow` groups for the ones you want, such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended. Otherwise their behavior is undefined and you can't tell blocking from omission. ## High **3. `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:3`: ``** - An empty description is worse than none, because Google writes its own snippet. AI answer engines get no summary. - **Fix:** write a unique description, for example "Bilge pumps, cleats and rope for boats, shipped next day." **4. `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte:5`: broken or thin structured data** - `{@html ...}` inside `` can work, but this is fragile. Svelte can mangle the `` in dynamic data would break out of it. - The `Product` has only a `name`. Google requires `offers` (price, currency, availability) for product rich results, and recommends `image` and `description`. - This is a category page that lists several items, so a single Product is the wrong type. - **Fix:** use `CollectionPage` with `ItemList`, or put a full `Product` on each product page. Build the JSON in code and escape `<` as `\u003c`. **5. `src/routes/+layout.svelte`: no site-wide metadata** - There is no `` (see item 8), no Open Graph or Twitter tags, no `Organization` or `WebSite` JSON-LD, and no default title or description. - **Fix:** add these in the layout. Pages can override the title and description. ## Medium **6. `src/routes/search/+page.svelte:2` and `src/routes/+layout.svelte:7`: titles and the `data-nosnippet` block** - The title "Search" is generic. Since the page is `noindex`, this matters little. - Two other things are worth checking: - `
Free delivery over £50.
` hides the delivery offer from snippets and AI previews. That is probably unintended. Remove it if you want this information surfaced. - The `noindex` on search is correct. Don't also disallow `/search` in robots.txt, because crawlers must be able to fetch the page to see the `noindex`. **7. `src/routes/+page.svelte:2`: weak title** - "Quay: boat parts" is short and brand-first. A title like "Marine Boat Parts, Shipped Next Day | Quay" carries more keywords. - The page is also only an `

`, with no body copy. There is nothing for search engines or LLMs to quote. - **Fix:** add descriptive content, such as categories, delivery terms, and an FAQ. Link to `/shop`. **8. `src/app.html:2`: `` has no `lang` attribute** - **Fix:** use ``. The £ sign suggests a UK audience. It also helps accessibility and language targeting. - Also add `` after line 4. Mobile-first indexing needs it, and it's missing. **9. `static/sitemap.xml:3-4`: no ``** - Both URLs lack `lastmod`, which helps crawlers prioritise recrawls. - The sitemap is hand-written. It will drift as products are added, so generate it from routes. It also has no individual product URLs yet. ## Low - `src/routes/search/+page.svelte` and `src/routes/shop/+page.svelte`: titles are generic ("Search", "Shop all parts"). Add the brand and a keyword, for example "Boat Parts: Bilge Pumps, Cleats & Rope | Quay". - `src/app.html:8`: the extra `
` around `%sveltekit.body%` is harmless. SvelteKit's docs recommend it, so no change is needed. - `src/routes/+layout.svelte:5`: navigation is plain links, which is crawlable. Add `aria-label="Main"` for accessibility. - Missing files for GEO: - `static/llms.txt` with a short site summary and key links. It's an emerging convention that few engines read, so treat it as optional. - A favicon and a social image. - 404 and error pages. ## Suggested order of fixes 1. Remove `ssr = false` (`+layout.ts:1`). 2. Remove the Googlebot block (`robots.txt:4-5`). 3. Fill in the shop description (`shop/+page.svelte:3`). 4. Fix the structured data (`shop/+page.svelte:5`). 5. Add `lang` and viewport (`app.html`). 6. Add layout-level metadata and site JSON-LD. 7. Add content to the home page. I haven't built or run the site. These findings come from reading the source. I can apply the fixes if you want.
